content:
The AWS SDKs (except the Android and iOS SDKs) support all the operations that are deﬁned in
the Amazon OpenSearch Service API Reference, including the CognitoOptions parameter for the
CreateDomain and UpdateDomainConfig operations. For more information about installing and
using the AWS SDKs, see AWS Software Development Kits.
After your domain ﬁnishes processing, see the section called “Allowing the authenticated role” and
the section called “Conﬁguring identity providers” for additional conﬁguration steps.

hierarchy.parent: Conﬁguring a domain to use Amazon Cognito authentication
